text:
```yaml
name: Close inactive issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close_inactive_issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale issues
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-issue-stale: 700
          days-before-issue-close: 30
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-issue-message: "This issue has been marked stale due to inactivity."
          close-issue-message: "Closing this issue due to inactivity."
          exempt-issue-labels: data-issue
          only-issue-types: issue
```
